title: County unemployment gauge
intent: Show a real county unemployment rate against three policy-neutral rate bands with a centered needle and value.
features: native radial rule ticks and needle

ai.create: Create a semicircular gauge directly from a county's rate field in Observable Plot's U.S. unemployment data, with three native pie sectors, eleven radial tick rules, a scale-driven radial rule needle, a radial dot hub, and a centered value label.
ai.maintain: Change the selected county without changing threshold or tick boundaries; preserve semantic mark keys, flat pie lineage, the zero-to-thirty-percent angle domain, the responsive radius, and native polar mark ownership.
